emails.subject: empty rooms at cedar gate
emails.a: I saw Cedar Gate is hiring a leasing coordinator in Beirut. How many rooms in your Achrafieh business center sit empty for part of the week? On ProHost, doctors, trainers and consultants book rooms like those by the hour, shift or month, without a lease.
emails.b: An office between tenants still costs Cedar Gate every month. ProHost fills those gaps: list each room once, rent it by the hour, day or month to phone-verified professionals, and booked slots lock automatically, so nothing is double-booked.
emails.c: Cedar Gate could earn from its Achrafieh rooms before the next long lease is signed. Space owners on ProHost rent rooms by the hour, shift or month to professionals across Lebanon, with no commission on bookings.
